recommendation_summary: The reply recommends setting up one external heartbeat check, such as Healthchecks.io, that the script pings on success and that emails the user if no ping arrives within 24 hours.

labels.Requirements and who asked: you asked to know within a day if nightly-sync fails without reading logs; you suggested a central log on Synology in Docker.
labels.Deleted: central log platform and moving everything to Docker for this one job.
labels.Bottleneck: startup crash happens before the email step, so a success email can never report its own failure.
labels.Checked myself: nightly-sync runs at 03:00 on edna, emails only on finish, was dead 4 nights from expired token with no alert, Synology can run Docker.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert, and all four record lines are specific to this case and come before the recommendation.
